'忍者神龟'是我童年最喜欢的动画， 就如同我曾经最喜欢的女孩。 只是， 时隔多年， 我依然可以玩到'忍者神龟'的游戏。 但分手以后， 我再也没干过那个女孩了。 好想让她和'忍者神龟'一样一直陪在我身边， 当我的炮友啊。

本作游戏以经典的忍者神龟的IP，搭配了俯视角快节奏的动作战斗Roguelite玩法，形成了一款独特的游戏。与同类型游戏相比，本作游戏更加推崇玩家联机合作而非单打独斗，单人游玩的难度更高且容易眼花缭乱。游戏有着不错的局内成长和局外成长曲线，丰富的碎片化剧情内容中，带领玩家不断了解整个世界和事件的真相。 [h1]熟悉的忍者神龟们回来了[/h1] 在我的童年时期，忍者神龟是一个非常出名的IP，可以说是家喻户晓。本作游戏的故事背景设定在动画中的纽约，玩家将可以扮演四只各具特色的忍者神龟——莱昂纳多、米开朗基罗、拉斐尔和多纳泰罗，踏上拯救被大脚帮囚禁的“父亲”斯普林特大师的冒险之旅。游戏剧情紧凑，充满了忍者神龟系列特有的幽默与热血，同时也不乏对原著角色的合理编排和原创剧情的巧妙融入，甚至游戏中的反派都是动画中耳熟能详的反派们。加上游戏漫画式的画风，那种经典的感觉一下就回来了。 [h1]搭配了全新的肉鸽玩法[/h1] 《忍者神龟：破碎命运》采用了Roguelite元素的随机生成关卡机制，每轮游戏都会带来全新的挑战和惊喜。玩家需要操控神龟们在大脚帮的势力范围内战斗，通过清理房间、击败敌人来获取奖励和强化道具，逐步提升自己的实力。每次开始游戏都会从下水道开始，经历多个场景和多个关卡。每个场景中会包括一个关中boss和一个关底boss，难度会逐渐提升。随着玩家开启不同的关卡，敌人的强度和数量也会大大增加。 游戏的战斗系统简洁而流畅，玩家可以通过普通攻击给其他的技能和远程攻击技能充能，也就是说玩家不断的攻击战斗就可以释放更多的技能。而普通攻击的最后一段动作还具有独立关键词“终结打击”，增加了动作连段的构筑环节，为角色的成长赋予更多的方向和优势。本作游戏玩起来动作还算流畅，但是因为动作的变形并不多，加上部分角色的手比较短，所以一开始玩的时候会觉得有些难受。当角色随着不断成长的时候，才能感觉到渐进佳境。 [h1]互补的角色设计和多人联机玩法[/h1] 游戏中的角色设计部分也非常出色，四只神龟各自拥有独特的技能和动作模组，擅长的方向也各不相同。玩家可以通过不断的更换角色游玩来找到更加适合自己的角色。玩游戏中玩家单打独斗会感觉到有些吃力，即便游戏提供了更简单的模式供给单人玩家游玩，但是我个人依然非常推荐玩家能够联机合作游玩。本作游戏支持本机合作和线上合作，玩家们可以选择不同的角色们共同参与到这场战斗中，相互取长补短，获取最终的胜利。联机游玩可以大大降低游戏的难度，并且获得更多的乐趣。 [h1]不错的局内和局外成长曲线[/h1] 游戏引入了一系列成长系统包括强化系统、神器系统和局外养成系统等，让玩家可以在战斗之余进行深度的角色构筑和策略规划。强化系统允许玩家通过关卡推进获得各类强化填充并构筑自己的角色，有一些会提升后续几个房间里的暂时的属性，有一些可以在整局中提高能力和一些技能的变种。神器系统则提供了各种不同的主动和被动强化道具，帮助玩家应对更强大的敌人，局外养成系统则包含了飞龙升级和梦想家升级，让玩家可以在游戏外进行数值调整和策略规划。游戏的局外成长相当丰富，玩家每次提升了局外成长之后都能在游戏过程中感受到明显的变化，也间接的降低了游戏在后期的难度。 [h1][quote=] [table] [tr] [th] 欢迎关注 [b][u][i]U_U鉴赏家培养计划[/i][/u][/b][/th] [/tr] [tr] [th] 关注U_U鉴赏家，开启精彩游戏之旅。 [/th] [/tr] [/table] [/quote][/h1]

[h1]忍者神龟IP之下的又一力作，虽有缺陷，但整体体验还算不错[/h1] 作为笔者童年回忆经典IP的《忍者神龟》系列在之前受到了诸多玩家好评的清版动作游戏《施莱德的复仇》之后，再一次推出了这款俯视角肉鸽游戏，游戏在玩法上汲取了《哈迪斯》的部分设定，同时加入了一些忍者神龟题材之下的内容，游戏的整体体验还算不错，但是遗憾的是本作的一些小细节还仍待改善。 [h1][quote=] [table] [tr] [th] 欢迎关注 [b][u][i]U_U鉴赏家培养计划[/i][/u][/b][/th] [/tr] [tr] [th] 关注U_U鉴赏家，开启精彩游戏之旅。 [/th] [/tr] [/table] [/quote][/h1] [h1]当忍者神龟遇上肉鸽[/h1] 如果说上一款推出的《施莱德的复仇》完美的继承了清版动作游戏的精髓，为数不多的缺点就是流程偏短，那么本作显然也在核心的肉鸽部分没有太大的问题，《哈迪斯》的多属性选择框架之下搭配上不同部位的限定技能合单独的属性增益，同时游戏中共有五个角色可以选择，每个角色都有着不同的特性合攻击方式，而这些元素也让本作的build构筑部分变得较为充实。 但是本作也依旧有着一些不足之处，首先个人只推荐有手柄的玩家游玩这款游戏，因为这款游戏的攻击是玩家面向哪个方向向那个方向攻击，鼠标点击攻击只能进行攻击不能进行方向选择，而这时候玩家想要攻击一个方向的敌人首先需要按下对应的方向键，此时再使用攻击才行，设置里面笔者没有找到更改的设置，而手柄的体验相较于键鼠就好上很多。 其次就是游戏的攻击动作，制作组给游戏中的攻击动作以及技能大部分都配上了非常大的特效，而本作中的特效和哈迪斯中的还有着一些区别，哈迪斯中的攻击虽然也有特效的加持，但是其并不会遮挡武器的攻击，这就让玩家很容易看出自己打没打中，但是本作中的攻击和技能的特效直接掩盖了武器本身，同时攻击的招式不同范围有着很大的差异，而技能更是有着椭圆形的，四个方向的攻击范围不同，明明看着敌人再攻击范围里但是却打不到，确实有些难受。 而抛开上面所说的这些问题来讲，本作的体验还是肉鸽游戏中较为不错的，制作组没有为难而难，游戏整体的难度曲线设计的较为合理，同时游戏中量大管饱没关一次的属性增强更是加快了玩家的战力成型，游戏对局之外也有着局外成长环节，四个忍者神龟的动作都有着之前一些作品中的味道，同时每个角色的特性感觉也是根据其角色定位莱设计的，这部分小细节的设计让笔者感受到了制作组的诚意。 总结 如果你喜欢忍者神龟可以尝试以下这款俯视角肉鸽游戏，虽有缺点，但体验尚可。

玩了100个小时，不是很推荐玩，理由如下：1.无法联机，只能单机玩，而且前期没有数值纯坐牢。 2.游戏优化一般，会有莫名其妙的卡顿，特别是那个吉吉那那里，打起来必卡，特别是挑战模式，一卡吃点技能半管血就下去了，玩的很难受。 3.技能组合只能说依托，我玩了100个小时一共就组合出三个传奇技能，而且我至今还不知道是几个技能组合的，像哈迪斯还有技能组合提示，这里完全没有，全靠自己乱凑。 4.游戏的养成做的也很一般，将近一半的神器一点叼用都没有，有些梦想币和飞龙币完全不知道说的是啥，里面好多升级不能说没用，只能说用处基本没有。4.挑战传送门奖励同质化严重，只给东西或者加梦想币和飞龙币，然后给一堆负面buff，没有任何正面buff，下水道还能勉强打打，后几关再进门就纯纯恶心自己，没有任何的挑战欲望。 5.通关很无聊，救出师傅之后竟然什么都没有，（7次通关救出师傅之前也什么都没有--，只给了一堆师傅的贴身物品，我尼玛，我第一次打完给了我一个师傅的权杖，我以为是什么神器，在房间里找来找去，后面发现就是个贴图。。。。差点气得我卸游戏）冲着救出师傅我还以为有什么新的神器和模式或者能选师傅玩，结果连个屁都没有，怎么说呢，就感觉玩了这么久通了个寂寞。 6.流派强度失衡，目前玩下来个人感觉只有水遁一刀流和飞镖流强一些，其他不是不能通关，总感觉强度差点意思，虽然数值堆上去了杂技流都能通关。 7 每个房间打完的奖励做的也是一言难尽，经常几个房间什么技能都不给，全是飞龙 梦想 废料三选一，有时候我就想问一句骰子有什么用？因为基本都是刷再多还是这些垃圾。

[h3] 你的缺点有点松弛，但是呢，相应的优点又弥补了这一部分 [/h3] 仿哈迪斯的玩法保证了游戏可玩性的下限，冲刺的超级无敌帧也提高了上限。当然冲刺cd单独的计算机制又稍微提高了难度，不至于成为轮椅，算是恰到好处的平衡吧。但比起榜样打击感差的太多，真正玩起来少了一丝爽感（当然，就一丝）。 剧情方面有点意义不明，但在童年情怀ip加成这类瑕疵都可以忽略不计。反正来玩这游戏的不是战斗爽就是感受并肩作战的兄弟情的，把兄弟几个人的人设立住了就好，谁管你故事讲的怎么样？我只要一边和兄弟们嬉笑打闹一边一拳把boss打飞！ 接上文，玩这游戏自然是联机有意思，但国区貌似无法联机（我全程单人通关，有想过联机但看评论打消了念头）。 传送门的设计挺有意思，但奖励千篇一律没什么吸引力，打多了容易腻。 总的来说是一款值得一玩的作品，但原价还是不值，建议打折再说。

I've always loved TMNT since the 80s cartoon and welcomed a rogue like/lite game but after playing this for a while it's unfortunate this game aint it. The biggest problem I have is with the progression- there's different currencies for different perks at three different places with no way to easily swap between them. I hate it. And along with that, the upgrades/perks you can get are just really underwhelming or something I have zero interest in. The menus are annoying to navigate with some awful UI design which to me is a huge negative for this genre of games. Devs should take a note from Tesla vs Lovecraft for how to do all of that the right way. Next is dialogue. Holy crap. The amount of dialogue in this game is ridiculous. And 90% of it interrupts gameplay. Huge negative for me. No options to reduce or maybe even have them talk while I'm actually playing instead...which leads to the levels are just one little area you fight enemies in, then go to the waypoint, fades to black and loads the next "room". I was expecting the stitched together stuff but I was also expecting levels. Like the 20xx game does it. Places I can walk through and do a touch of light exploring, smashing stuff, getting money etc. Nope. It's load a room, fade to black, load another room, etc etc. Kinda disappointed in that. Really killed the flow for me. For special abilities and tools, it's extremely difficult to tell in the UI that when the cool down is over, so you'll either guess or constantly looking at the upper left corner of the screen like I did. Really needs a sound effect and/or bright light effect around the circle so I can see it out the corner of my eye. The voice acting just doesn't do it for me. Maybe the voices from the 80s cartoon are forever locked in my monkey brain as how everyone should sound. But in this game I swear I couldn't tell much of a difference between Leonardo, Michaelangelo and Donatello at all. Raphael has a nice distinct voice as does April. But Splinter, Shredder and Casey Jones voice acting doesn't really have a good type of voice for them. It's really bad. I appreciate the devs still updating and adding optional dlc but unless they do some major UI revamping I think I'm done with this game.

Cowabung~eh~ 4/10 Almost a shameless take on the Hades loop, but without understanding what makes that game an instant classic. Speaking of classics, the enemy roster severely suffers compared to the classic arcade games; there is very little variety, in either enemies or environments. The dialogue further adds to the stagnation - stale as week old pizza The game is either fairly easy or really frustrating. It is generally not too difficult to avoid getting hit. However, late game consists of almost constant dodging to avoid getting one-shotted by never-ending barrages of enemy combos Knocking off an extra point for the high pricepoint DLC for characters that easily could have been added to the base game and prevent 100% completion. This was delivered with slices missing This can be worth it for some enjoyment if you really like Hades and are Jonesing for more, but don't expect that much from it

Game sure plays smoothly. Game is pretty good fighting game, with popular TMNT heroes and enemies. What gets on the bad side is the amount of grinding you need to unlock to proceed. Each run will net you some 300-400 coins, and later single upgrade costs 400 coins or even more. Each such run takes around 30 minutes, so.... a lot of grinding for minor upgrades. Enemies start to deal insane damage in Act 3 and shielded enemies completely ignore your attacks until their shield goes down. Here's a cliche "I really wanted to love this game." and I did, but I don't. It certainly doesn't deserve a "Very Positive" Steam rating. I just can't fathom that this game has been around for almost two years, yet unforgivable and game breaking inconsistencies still exist. The real problem though, is that the base level design, and coding for multiplayer, is rotten to the core. It's dumb beyond belief. There is no MP lobby. Lobby? What a fkn antiquated concept. Instead, you get to roll the dice at the start screen while the seconds count down, and you admire your pretty 30 ping. Firstly hoping that you aren't going to end up on a team that is halfway through a run. Then, at the same time also praying to a non-existant god, that the same team is running something maybe a level up from a timber pc powered by penguin poop on a 300 bps modem out of Antarctica. The entire premise of the game is about "building your build". So which FW thought it would be clever to dump players into a game when half the team is 'built' already? Completely defeats the fun of the game, also makes it next to impossible to complete certain achievements. Lack of lobby stupidity excluded, there isn't even an option to "Create MP game." of your own. So you can't even just start an MP run from scratch on your own. You HAVE to roll the dice, WTFF?!? Oh and here's one for you players who love to add insult to injury. If you do happen to be lucky enough to create an MP game. You get kicked for idle waiting for other players even if you're the only player and the creator. Yup, next level fktard sht. The guys who dropped the balls on this basic shizz, are, quite literally, the definition of moronic FWs. If I was you idiots, I would be sure to leave this failure, and any reference to it, or the company involved, out of your LinkedIn profile. There is no polish here, this game could have been something good, but it isn't. The multiplayer is a poorly implemented after thought, and the chumps in charge obviously don't GAF cause they've done nothing to fix it. You don't need my review. Buy the game. Play the game. Realise how broken MP is. Get a refund.

Verdict: It is somewhere between not good but not bad either. It needed more polish, more variety and more areas to play in because the runs feel all the same. Recommended on sale due to aforementioned issues. + Positives + + Steam trading cards (5 drop, 9 to make a badge) + Steam achievements (79, multiple playthroughs, 1 requires DLC) + Clearly inspired by Hades + All turtles feel unique + Tons of tools, specials and combinations to discover + Quite fun for a few hours + Great TMNT soundtrack + Couch co-op and online co-op (up to 4 players) + If a host has Casey Jones & the Junkyard Jam DLC you can experience it + 19 artifacts to pick from at the start of your run (think Hades Keepsakes) + The gameplay loop is quite fun + pretty to look at – Negatives – - You can get really screwed by RNG rewards (you get 2-4 rewards and they can all be just meta currency at the same time) - The story is pretty 'meh' at best (I was expecting new areas or bosses as it progresses but no) - I was hoping for more TMNT characters and bosses - No boss variety (you always face the same ones in the same order) - Some arenas are just plain unfair and feel like you are bound to be hit - No glossary for item combinations - The meta upgrades make you too strong quite fast (the game is easier and easier) - in 10 hours my damage was +150%, my hp +130%, + 3 revives, +3 dashes, +60% healing etc .... I could literally face tank the first boss on hard thanks to that - Really small enemy variety - Enemies are apparently throwing homing shurikens (they correct they path mid air) - The hub is just lifeless after the first 2 hours. You cannot talk to anyone there or upgrade it in any way with decorations - Terrible with mouse+keyboard (it is incredibly easy to lose track of your aim)

Combining Hades-like (action rouge) elements with (nostalgic) TMNT setting was a great move, which created one extremely fun game with the "just one more run" / loop addictive approach. Turtles having their unique fighting styles, which in combination with passive bonuses/biomes and tools you choose after each room, provide opportunity to create interesting combinations. Plus, you collect Dragon and Dream coins to further upgrading passive bonuses that are permanent through the entire games (+ you can unlock various artifacts). Encounters (especially with bosses and mini-bosses) are also fun. Gameplay is fluid, music is good and atmosphere is great. One element where this game also shines is multiplayer/PvE element - if you are lucky to find people online playing the game, the fun is guaranteed! It is worth owning all three DLCs (adding new characters, bonuses and a completely new area) for complete experience. Absolute recommendation!
